purpose: Decide how each real product journey relates to Kit before adopting or swapping a visual system.
boundary: This assessment covers design-system fit only. Checklist remains the authority for full-project launch readiness.

classifications.label: Already covered
classifications.description: Use an existing Kit piece without changing the product journey.
classifications.action: Map the journey to the existing piece and prove the populated state.

classifications.label: Compose pieces
classifications.description: Join existing pieces into this product's own screen or workflow.
classifications.action: Keep the composition in the product and install only the pieces it uses.

classifications.label: Add to Kit
classifications.description: Promote a reusable cross-product need once so every complete kit gains it.
classifications.action: Pause adoption, build the generic piece in Kit, prove every complete system, then resume.

classifications.label: Keep in product
classifications.description: The route, data, policy, content, or business behavior belongs only to this product.
classifications.action: Protect it from kit swaps and pass only visual roles into it.

approval: Every important product journey is classified.
Every shared gap is resolved in all complete kits before adoption.
Product-owned rules and layouts remain outside Kit.
The same populated journeys are proved before and after adoption.
The previous appearance remains recoverable without undoing product work.
